hooks.text: 用身体侧闪弹幕和等离子火力，并以冲刺、滑行、磨轨穿越峡谷与城市
hooks.excerpt: Feel the most kinetic combat available in a headset as you sprint, slide, and grind across scorched canyons and futuristic cities. Total Immersion: Physically weave through bullet hell, dodge incoming plasma fire with your own body, and return the favor with pinpoint precision.

hooks.text: 霰弹枪后坐、拉弓和近战均为实体交互，武器还需手动换弹
hooks.excerpt: Visceral Firepower: Feel the kick of high-powered shotguns, physically draw back a high-tension bow, or shred bots up close with razor-sharp melee weapons. Master Your Tools: Utilize interactive weapon handling and manual reloading to stay in the fight.

hooks.text: 动态生成敌军遭遇让关卡持续变化，机器人会适应并由巨型Boss收尾
